title: Farmers’ Purchasing Behavior and Implications for Suppliers’ Go-To-Market Strategies
publisher: Purdue University Center for Food and Agricultural Business
notes: LCP survey; category-specific importance of price/performance/relationship. Do not universalize outside sampled context.

title: Performance Over Price: How farmers' input buying behavior is evolving
publisher: Purdue University Center for Food and Agricultural Business
notes: Trend analysis for seed/feed; highlights increasing weight of performance/ROI.

title: How U.S. Farmers Perceive Agricultural Dealers and Retailers
publisher: Purdue University Center for Food and Agricultural Business
notes: Relationships remain loyalty anchor while technical sophistication and service expectations rise.

title: How farmers interact with agribusiness reps
publisher: Purdue University Center for Food and Agricultural Business
notes: Farmer Decision-Making survey; roles of advisers and interaction patterns.

title: Procurement Strategies of Commercial Producers
publisher: Purdue University Center for Food and Agricultural Business
notes: Useful procurement dimensions: performance, price, delivery, technical support, financing, warranty, information services.

title: The impact of generative AI on B2B sales performance
publisher: Purdue University Center for Food and Agricultural Business
notes: Agribusiness application of GenAI; emphasizes admin reduction, personalization, leadership, workflow integration and governance.

title: The SPIN Methodology – 50 years of changing behaviours
notes: Official methodology source for Situation, Problem, Implication, Need-payoff.

title: Rethinking SPIN – the universal framework
notes: SPIN developed from large-scale observation of sales calls; use as methodology, not rigid script.

title: What is the Challenger Sales Methodology?
notes: Teach, Tailor, Take Control, constructive tension; fit for complex B2B decisions.

title: What Is Negotiation? Understanding the Seven Elements
notes: Interests, options, BATNA, legitimacy, communication, relationship, commitments.

title: What is BATNA?
notes: BATNA as best alternative if no agreement; informs walk-away and leverage.

title: Six Guidelines for Getting to Yes
notes: Focus on interests, options and objective criteria rather than pressure.

title: Partial Budgeting: A Tool to Analyze Farm Business Changes
publisher: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach
notes: Partial budget: added income, reduced costs, added costs, reduced income.

title: Farmers can improve outcomes with a few decision-making tools
notes: Partial budget, premortem and red-team approaches to farm decisions.

title: Farm finance
notes: Cost of production, breakeven and scenario comparison; use farm-specific costs when possible.

title: Orchard IPM – An Overview
notes: Scouting, thresholds, economics, control tactics; relevant as decision pattern, not crop-specific prescription.

title: Scouting is Key to Insect Pest Management in Spring
notes: Scouting reduces risk of both overlooked pests and unnecessary applications.

title: AGROFIT
notes: Official database for registered crop-protection products and approved uses.

title: Adubação, produtividade e rentabilidade da rotação entre soja e milho
notes: Evidence that fertility-built soils require fertilizer management adjustments and economic analysis; case-specific results must not be generalized.

title: Indicações metodológicas para a realização de ensaios on-farm
notes: On-farm trials as structured method to test products/processes/doses/interactions under farm conditions.

title: Apoio à decisão na adoção da agricultura de precisão
notes: Highlights need for simple decision-support tools in precision-ag adoption.

title: Condicionantes da adoção de inovações
notes: Technical assistance and context influence technology adoption; avoid framing non-adoption as irrational.

title: AgroAvances / Abordagem Comportamental para Adoção de Inovação
notes: Behavioral economics and social psychology can support study of adoption; use scientifically and avoid manipulative profiling.

title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
notes: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage; voluntary framework for trustworthy AI risk management.

title: NIST AI RMF: Generative AI Profile
notes: Companion profile for GenAI risks; useful for provenance, evaluation, monitoring and human oversight.

title: ANPD – Documentos técnicos e orientativos
publisher: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados
notes: Official Brazilian privacy/data-protection guidance; legal implementation requires qualified review.

title: Practice for knowledge acquisition (not drill and kill)
notes: Practice supports knowledge/skill acquisition; deliberate practice uses attention, rehearsal and repetition.

title: A Novel Test of Deliberate Practice Theory
notes: Deliberate practice is effortful, targeted, repetitive and feedback-rich.

title: Salesperson Adaptive Selling Behavior and Customer Orientation: A Meta-Analysis
notes: Adaptive selling behavior is positively associated with multiple performance measures; customer orientation has more nuanced effects.

title: Sales training: effects of spaced practice on training transfer
publisher: European Journal of Training and Development / Emerald
notes: Field study of spaced practice in sales training; supports reinforcement rather than one-off training.

title: AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS Self-Study Guide to Hedging with Grain and Oilseed Futures and Options
notes: Exchange-published educational guide covering basis, hedging mechanics and residual basis risk.

title: World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE)
notes: Official monthly US government balance-sheet report for major grains and oilseeds; supply, use and stocks by category.

title: B3 + Agro
notes: Exchange-published description of Brazilian agricultural derivatives, including the Brazil Soybean futures contract developed with CME Group.

title: Acompanhamento da Safra Brasileira de Grãos
notes: Official monthly Brazilian government crop survey; area, productivity, production, climate and market analysis from a nationwide agent network and satellite monitoring.

title: Custos de Produção - Metodologia
notes: Official standard cost-of-production methodology separating variable cost, operational cost (with depreciation) and total cost (with land/capital remuneration).

title: Resistência de fungos a fungicidas
notes: Application-window discipline and mode-of-action rotation limit repeated selection pressure and delay fungicide resistance in soybean diseases.

title: Correção da acidez superficial do solo no Cerrado: recomendação para utilização de calcário
notes: Liming timing (2-3 months ahead of planting) and PRNT-adjusted dose as determinants of effective soil acidity correction.

title: Resistência de plantas daninhas
notes: Repeated use of the same herbicide mechanism of action under monoculture/no-till increases resistance selection risk; crop and herbicide rotation are core countermeasures.

title: Behavioral Preferences and Price Risk Management in Agriculture: A Systematic Literature Review
publisher: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics / Cambridge University Press
notes: Systematic review; mixed evidence on how risk aversion relates to adoption and hedging behavior across farm studies.

title: Farmers' Risk-Based Decision Making Under Pervasive Uncertainty: Cognitive Thresholds and Hazy Hedging
notes: Farmers satisfice rather than optimize under multifaceted uncertainty; risk and ambiguity preferences are distinct decision dimensions.

title: Volatilização de amônia após aplicação de ureia em cobertura no milho safrinha na Amazônia Mato-Grossense
notes: Regional field study (Amazônia Mato-Grossense, off-season corn); measured ammonia volatilization loss magnitude is condition-specific (soil, climate, timing) and must not be generalized as a fixed percentage.

title: Boas práticas para o enfrentamento da ferrugem-asiática da soja
publisher: Embrapa Soja (Godoy, C.V.; Seixas, C.D.S.; Soares, R.M.; Meyer, M.C.; Costamilan, L.M.; Adegas, F.S.)
notes: Sanitary break, early cultivars and multi-site fungicide rotation as core management practices; loss magnitude (up to 90%) is a without-control ceiling, not an expected outcome.

title: Manejo Integrado de Pragas da Soja (MIP-Soja)
notes: Technology/solution page describing the MIP-Soja approach and stink-bug action-level reference (cloth-beating sampling); exact numeric thresholds should be confirmed against the current technical circular before use in a specific case.

title: Manejo do mofo branco
publisher: Embrapa Arroz e Feijão (Lobo Junior, M.; Santos, P.F.)
notes: Integrated management (rotation, no-till straw cover, biological control, fungicides) reduces incidence; the disease is not eliminated by any single practice.

title: Efeito da população de plantas e do espaçamento sobre a produtividade de milho
publisher: Revista Brasileira de Milho e Sorgo / Embrapa Milho e Sorgo (Dourado Neto, D. et al.)
notes: Yield response to plant population and row spacing depends on hybrid leaf architecture; findings come from field trials with three genotypes, not a universal rule across all hybrids/regions.

title: Zoneamento Agrícola de Risco Climático (ZARC)
notes: ZARC defines lower-agroclimatic-risk planting windows by municipality/crop and underpins eligibility for rural credit and agricultural insurance; consult the official MAPA panel for the current-season window.

title: Armazenamento inadequado de grãos resulta em cerca de 15% de perdas
notes: News item citing internal Embrapa estimates; loss magnitude is an approximation, not a precise universal figure, and varies by storage structure and management.
